$comment: Designer: <= 3.0s to an interactive shell, <= 350 KB with the heavy modules lazy. Konva and the 3D preview are the reason this budget is its own. RATCHET: the target in docs/performance-budgets.md is 350 KB of initial JS; F4 Part D measures 456 KB (518 KB before jsPDF was removed in F4 Part C; three.js loads only with the 3D tab, ADR-0010), so the assertion is pinned just above the current figure. It stops the number growing while the gap is worked down — it is not the budget. Lower the ceiling whenever a change wins headroom; never raise it without saying why in docs/PROGRESS.md.
